placeholders.faq_questions: What's in the formula?|Is it pregnancy safe?|Is it safe for everyone?|What is the benefit of the cloth?
placeholders.faq_answer: Each cloth is infused with 3½ teaspoons of a clinical-grade cream containing hyaluronic acid, glycerin, shea butter, cocoa butter, chamomile, adenosine, and other barrier-strengthening actives. See the full ingredient list in the product details above.
